description: Get one Iconaut icon by its exact name: the SVG source at a native size, the iconaut-react import, the shadcn/ui registry command and the CDN URL. 16, 20 and 24 are native sizes, each with its own stroke weight; 16 is also a simplified drawing with less detail, while 20 and 24 share the full drawing. Ask for the size the icon will be shown at. Colors come from currentColor.

name.description: Exact icon name, e.g. "settings" or "arrow-left". Find it with search_icons.

size.description: Pixel size. 16, 20 and 24 are native sizes; any other value returns the nearest one.

style.description: line (stroked), solid (filled) or duo (25% tint under the line).

name: get_icon
title: Get an Iconaut icon
